items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: I happened to be in the beauty spring, he'd come here to get me to play a job with him, and we played over there.

ctx.x: Did you ever know Dan Moody?

Oh yes, Dan Moody from Madisonville, he played trombone and bass. Matter of fact he just died about a year or two years ago. Can you tell us anything about him? Not in particular, I didn't play with Dan until 1952, let me see, it was the year that President Roosevelt died. I happened to be in the beauty spring, he'd come here to get me to play a job with him, and we played over there. You don't know what? And he had been playing with different fellas we'd make up groups from out of Punchitula and Covington, he…
He used to come here and get Sheep to go to the Covington Fair with him.
